## About
Rossetti's Collision Service is an auto body shop on State Road in Philadelphia. We help repair minor or major damage across all vehicle makes, using original equipment or high quality replacement parts at fair prices.
Reviewers know the owner, Mike Rossetti, by name. One calls him "a hands on owner," and another says he "treats his customers like family." We hold a 5 rating from 22 Google reviews.
We'll do our best to make your collision repair as anxiety-free as possible.

## Services
- All kinds of auto body repair work: Small or major damage, across all vehicle makes.
- Accident and body repairs: Car accident? We'll get the body back in shape.
- Dent repairs: Minor dents and paint work our staff is happy to take care of.
- Finishing maintenance
- 24-Hour towing service
- Replacement Vehicle
- Tires and Winter Service

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work with all insurance companies.

Q: Do you repair my make of car?
A: We repair minor or major damage across all vehicle makes.

Q: How do I ask a question or set up a repair?
A: Give us a call or fill out the contact form on our site. Our employees are there for you.
